<b>Pilgrim Guides</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are old pilgrims who carry a heavy iron bell staff, once the leaders of climbing troupes before becoming [[Haunting|Haunted]].<ref>Pilgrim Guide [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Old pilgrim carrying a heavy iron bell staff. The large bell seems to signify them as once leader of a climbing troupe, though the Haunting has erased that former authority."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pilgrim Guides naturally walk when idle, except for the one in Greymoor who is leading a prayer. Once Hornet is in range, they use either of the following attacks:
* <b>Double Bonk:</b> Slams their staff at Hornet, pausing for a moment, then performs another slam. Moves forward with each slam.
* <b>Jump Slam:</b> Jumps either backwards or forwards and slams their bell staff down as they land.

Pilgrim Guides deal {{Damage|2}} with their bell staff, but only {{Damage|1}} on contact.

As for counterplay, baiting out their attacks and striking during the downtime is the best strategy, since they have a short cooldown between attacks and leave many openings.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pilgrim Guides have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Two consistently respawning Pilgrim Guides can be found in the middle of [[Greymoor]], east of [[Halfway Home]].
After defeating [[Shellwood]]'s [[Covetous Pilgrim]], a Pilgrim Guide can be found in the room it previously occupied, alongside a [[Pilgrim Bellbearer]].
A non-respawning Pilgrim Guide can also be found in [[the Marrow]]'s jail, but only before [[Loddie]]'s minigame is set up.
In [[Bonegrave]], one Pilgrim Guide can spawn as an enemy variant upon revisiting the area. Inside the [[Chapel of the Wanderer]], one is encountered as part of the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)#Chapel_of_the_Wanderer|gauntlet]].

During [[Act 3]], a Pilgrim Guide can be found in Shellwood attacking [[Pinmaster Plinney]].
